title: May I contact your references?
content: "May I contact your references?" The only correct answer to this question is a yes. If they have your references, then a simple yes will be enough. If they do not, then answer yes and offer them a list. "Sure. After the interview, I can email or fax you a list of references. Will that be ok?"

examples.sentence: Sure. After the interview, I can email or fax you a list of references. Will that be ok?
